book.name: 2 Kolɛŋ
book.title: Ŋwa wù kiŋgane kinfɛɛ wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ kintaashɛ ki Kolɛŋ le

content: Gɛ̀ cha Nyo Bol lɛ wu nyû mwa ntuŋ wu Jiso Kletu
Mɛ wù Bol kibɛɛ, ŋkude lo chiaaŋ bɛŋ le yi kimbonɛ bɛ nyiɛgee wu Kletu le. Le mɛ wù ba duu lɛ ŋge ndoo nyume kimbe kimi le njɛme fiɛɛ fì tɛɛme lo, nto a bɛŋ jii, mɛ mo mbo.
Nlɛgɛ lo bɛŋ lɛ sege ŋge nto, keefɛ bɛŋ gê njâ njɛ̂me fiɛɛ fì tɛɛme lo besabɛŋ no mɛ taŋlo njɛme besa bamii ba kwaji lɛ bee gee mwɛɛ bee bii nyu ŋkwajɛ wu bamii ba yi woŋ kfunɛ le gɛ.
Le nchiɛɛŋ lɛ bee chee yi woŋ kfunɛ le, geenɛ gɛ̀ bee ya tune jɛŋ yese bee bii no bamii ba yi woŋ kfunɛ le tune gɛ.
Gɛ mwɛɛ mu bee tune jɛŋ yese yu nyu mu yi woŋ kfunɛ le gɛ. Mwɛɛ mù bee tune jɛŋ yese yu kɛme bvuŋga bvu jade fɛ Nyo le, ki mu bvûushi manjuu mà tɛɛme yu.

Bee to be jode mwɛɛ mu jɛŋ lɛ munɛ bee bvuushi bintɛɛnyɛ bi bamii tɛɛnyi yu, bee shiishi kinchiaasɛ ye kichii kì baŋe lɛ keefɛ bamii kee Nyo gɛ, bee soo tɛ baŋkwajɛ ba bamii yu, bee gee bo yuge wa nyu Kletu le.
Sege bɛŋ dunyɛ lɛ bɛŋ yuge wa nyu Kletu le bɛ muntele mwɛna munchii, bee mo be nyâ ŋgɛ muh wuchii wu tɛɛme kikwɛɛ Kletu le.
Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ fiɛɛ fì le a bɛŋ jii! Nɛ muh wù kee nchiɛɛŋ lɛ wu le muh wu Kletu, wu kêe lɛ no wu le muh wu Kletu, le gɛh tɛ no bee le.
Mo nja ntu nchiaase ye nfede shige nje bvuŋga bvu bee kɛme bvu Tada nya, gɛ bvuya nyu bvu koode mɛ gɛ. Bvuŋga bvunɛ le ki bvu jooŋ lo nyu gɛ ki bvu sâ gɛ.
Gɛ ŋgoone lɛ fi duunyi nɛ njɛ mbɛɛŋse lo bɛŋ bɛ baŋwa baŋ gɛ.
Njɛme nɛ nje bamii bamu jade bo tu bo jɛme kune mɛ bo duu lɛ, “Wu to wu saŋe baŋwa ba jiji bo ka tɛɛme, geenɛ sege wu to a bamii jii wu mo wu tu wɛɛ. Gɛ njɛmɛ we to wu koode fiɛɛ le gɛ.”
Bobaa bamii kêe lɛ fiɛɛ fì bee jɛme a baŋwa le sege bee ya fo gɛ, bee lé be gê fi sege bee to.

Gɛ bee mone ki bee bêji ye, kɛnɛ ki bee fege bikwɛɛ biɛsa bɛ bamii bamu baa ba sɛŋe bɛ de yiboo fiɛɛ fì le bo gɛ. No bo fege bikwɛɛ biboo le lɛbolɛbo, bo beji tɛ ye yiboo lɛbolɛbo, fi duunyi lɛ gɛ bo kee fiɛɛ gɛ.
Fiesa le lɛ gɛ̀ bee chiaase ye bee fede kijwee gɛ. Bee chiaase ye nyu yi kijwee ki Nyo le wu nya chiaaŋ yese le ki bee lɛ̂ŋ bee tô be bû fɛ bɛŋ le.
Gɛ bee daŋse kijwee no bee too be bude fɛ bɛŋ le gɛ. Bee gɛ̀ bee bamii ba fwe ki be jiɛnyɛ bɛ saaka wù joŋe wu kune Kletu, too bude fɛ bɛŋ le.

Gɛ bee chiaase ye bee fede kijwee gɛ. Fi le lɛ gɛ̀ bee chiaase ye yi lɛme chi bamii bamu gee le gɛ. Geenɛ fiɛɛ fì bee jiiŋe fwe bee kee le lɛ no mbɛmɛ wene kuu wu gɛɛne fwe, le gɛh no lɛme chesa a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ le chi kûu chi gɛɛne fwe chuule.
Noo bee mo bee fê lo a bɛŋ le lɛ bee fêeji saaka wù joŋe wu gɛɛne bimbe bimi le, ya nyu gɛ lɛ bee chiaase ye bɛ lɛme chi ba le ba lɛŋ wa kijusɛ ki muh mu le gɛ.
Fi mo fi nyume no ba saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le lɛ,

content.text: wu chiaase ye nyume yi fiɛɛ fì ge Tada le.”

content: Gɛ nyu muh wu duunyi kikwɛɛ ke lɛ wu le muh wù kooji wu mo nyu muh wù kooji a Tada jii gɛ. Le muh wu Tada yɛde lɛ wu le wu kojɛ, le wù kooji a wu jii.
